info.name: AI Drama episode subtitle API
info.description: HTTP checks for multilingual episode subtitles against the running development API. Signed media URLs are inspected as metadata and never downloaded.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Entitled fixture login succeeds', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.uuid).to.equal(pm.variables.get('entitledUserUuid')); pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('entitledAccessToken', body.accessToken); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Unentitled fixture login succeeds', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.uuid).to.equal(pm.variables.get('unentitledUserUuid')); pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('unentitledAccessToken', body.accessToken); });

item.name: Free episode playback includes Korean and English subtitles

exec: pm.test('Anonymous free playback succeeds', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Playback retains its public response keys and returns sorted subtitle metadata', () => {
pm.expect(Object.keys(body).sort()).to.eql(['durationMs','episodeNumber','isSaved','subtitles','title','url','videoUuid'].sort());
pm.expect(body.durationMs).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.episodeNumber).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.isSaved).to.equal(false);
pm.expect(body.url).to.match(/^https:\/\/[^/]+\.s3\.[^/]+\.amazonaws\.com\//); pm.expect(body.url).to.match(/[?&]X-Amz-Expires=3600(?:&|$)/);
pm.expect(body.subtitles.map(item => item.languageCode)).to.eql(['en','ko']);

body.subtitles.forEach(item => { pm.expect(Object.keys(item).sort()).to.eql(['format','languageCode','url']); pm.expect(item.format).to.equal(item.languageCode === 'en' ? 'SRT' : 'VTT'); pm.expect(item.url).to.match(/^https:\/\/[^/]+\.s3\.[^/]+\.amazonaws\.com\//); pm.expect(item.url).to.match(/[?&]X-Amz-Expires=3600(?:&|$)/); });

item.name: Free episode playback accepts an authenticated user

exec: pm.test('Authenticated free playback succeeds and keeps both subtitle languages', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.subtitles.map(item => item.languageCode)).to.eql(['en','ko']); });

item.name: Paid episode playback for entitled user includes both languages

exec: pm.test('Entitled paid playback returns both sorted languages', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.subtitles.map(item => item.languageCode)).to.eql(['en','ko']); pm.expect(body.subtitles.map(item => item.format)).to.eql(['SRT','VTT']); });

item.name: Paid episode playback for anonymous user requires authentication

exec: pm.test('Anonymous paid playback returns 401 without media URLs', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(401); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('url'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('subtitles'); });

item.name: Paid episode playback denies an unentitled user

exec: pm.test('Unentitled paid playback returns 403 without media URLs', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(403); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.errorCode).to.equal('EPISODE_ACCESS_DENIED'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('url'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('subtitles'); });

item.name: English-only episode returns one SRT subtitle

exec: pm.test('English-only playback returns one exact SRT metadata item', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.subtitles).to.have.length(1); const [item] = body.subtitles; pm.expect(Object.keys(item).sort()).to.eql(['format','languageCode','url']); pm.expect(item.languageCode).to.equal('en'); pm.expect(item.format).to.equal('SRT'); pm.expect(item.url).to.match(/^https:\/\/[^/]+\.s3\.[^/]+\.amazonaws\.com\//); pm.expect(item.url).to.match(/[?&]X-Amz-Expires=3600(?:&|$)/); });

item.name: Episode without subtitles returns an empty array

exec: pm.test('Playback with no subtitle rows returns an empty array', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('subtitles').that.is.an('array').and.is.empty; });

item.name: Hidden episode playback is not public

exec: pm.test('Hidden episode is not found and exposes no URLs', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('url'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('subtitles'); });
